_comment: Dependency-free content classifier pattern set (docs/CLASSIFICATION.md). Each category has named regex patterns matched against ingested text + attachment text. luhn:true means candidate digit runs must additionally pass the Luhn check (so PCI never false-positives on ordinary numbers). Categories PII/PCI/Secret raise the item's advisorySensitivity tag to Restricted. Edit patterns here; no code change or redeploy of logic needed. Case-insensitive matching.
